decisions.choice: "ofrenda alzada" (L); "contribución" (B); "ofrenda apartada" (R)
decisions.reason: The word (terumah) comes from a verb for lifting off a part: a portion set apart for God and given to the priest. Literal keeps the image, as in Exodus 25 and 29; Readable follows the English "a gift set apart".

decisions.choice: "offrande élevée" (L); "contribution" (B); "un don mis à part" (R)
decisions.reason: The word (terumah) comes from a verb for lifting off a part: a portion set apart for God and given to the priest. Literal keeps the image, as in Exodus 25 and 29; Readable follows the English "a gift set apart".

decisions.choice: "sadaka ya kuinuliwa" (L); "mchango" (B); "zawadi iliyotengwa" (R)
decisions.reason: The word (terumah) comes from a verb for lifting off a part: a portion set apart for God and given to the priest. Literal keeps the image, as in Exodus 25 and 29; Readable follows the English "a gift set apart".

decisions.choice: "들어 바치는 제물" for the contribution (*terumah*)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet; the older "거제" is no longer understood, and the phrase says that the portion is lifted off and set apart for God and given to the priest.

decisions.choice: "của lễ dâng riêng" (Literal, Balanced); "của lễ để riêng ra cho" (Readable) for the contribution (terumah)
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch sheet's term for a portion taken off and set apart for God and his priests; Readable says the same in plainer words, as the English Readable says "a gift set apart". Book-wide for Leviticus 1-9.

decisions.choice: oferta alçada (L); contribuição (B); presente separado (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as Exodus 25:2 sets it: the portion taken off and set apart for God and given to the priest (m2; 7:32) is "oferta alçada" at Literal, the traditional name built on "lifting", and "contribuição" at Balanced; Readable says "presente separado", as the English Readable says "a gift set apart".

decisions.choice: "የሚነሣ መባ" (contribution, L, B); "የተለየ ስጦታ" (a gift set apart, R)
decisions.reason: The contribution is a portion lifted off and set apart for God and the priest (m2). Exodus 29 has "የሚነሣ መባ" at Literal and "መባ" at Balanced; in Leviticus plain "መባ" already renders the offering brought near (1:2), so Balanced keeps "የሚነሣ" to keep the two apart.

decisions.choice: "उठाई हुई भेंट" for the contribution (terumah) at every level
decisions.reason: A portion set apart for God and given to the priest (m2). Hindi names it "उठाई हुई भेंट" at every level, one term for terumah through the book, kept apart from "हिलाने की भेंट" (the wave offering); where the English Readable describes the thigh as set apart rather than naming the offering (7:34; 10:14), Readable does the same. The same through the book.

decisions.choice: "возношение" (L, B); "дар, отделённый для ГОСПОДА" (R)
decisions.reason: A portion set apart for God and given to the priest (m2). "Возношение" is the term used for the contribution in Exodus 25-29; Readable says what it is.

decisions.choice: terumah "献納物" (L, B), "取り分けてささげる物" (R), through Leviticus
decisions.reason: A portion set apart for God and given to the priest (meaning decision m2); the form of Exodus 29:27-28.

decisions.choice: "пожертва" (Literal, Balanced), "дар, відділений для" (Readable) for the contribution
decisions.reason: The word names a part set apart from an offering for God and his priests; "пожертва" says that, and Readable spells it out as the English Readable does. Book-wide choice.

source.text: וּבְשַׂ֗ר זֶ֚בַח תּוֹדַ֣ת שְׁלָמָ֔יו בְּי֥וֹם קָרְבָּנ֖וֹ יֵאָכֵ֑ל לֹֽא־יַנִּ֥יחַ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַד־בֹּֽקֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: And the meat of the sacrifice of the thanksgiving of his peace offerings on the day of his present it will be eaten; not he will leave any of it until morning.

en.L: And the flesh of the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings shall be eaten on the day of his offering; he shall not leave any of it until morning.
en.B: The meat of the peace offering given in thanks is to be eaten the same day it is offered. Nothing of it is to be kept until the next morning.
en.R: The meat of the thank offering must be eaten on the same day it is offered. Do not keep any of it until the next morning.

es.L: Y la carne del sacrificio de acción de gracias de su sacrificio de paz se comerá el día de su ofrenda; no dejará nada de ella hasta la mañana.
es.B: La carne del sacrificio de paz ofrecido en acción de gracias se comerá el mismo día en que se ofrezca. No se guardará nada de ella hasta la mañana siguiente.
es.R: La carne de la ofrenda de acción de gracias tiene que comerse el mismo día en que se ofrece. No guardes nada para la mañana siguiente.

fr.L: Et la chair du sacrifice d’action de grâce de son sacrifice de communion sera mangée le jour de son offrande ; il n’en laissera rien jusqu’au matin.
fr.B: La viande du sacrifice de communion offert en action de grâce sera mangée le jour même où on l’offre. On n’en gardera rien jusqu’au lendemain matin.
fr.R: La viande du sacrifice pour dire merci doit être mangée le jour même où il est offert. N’en garde rien jusqu’au lendemain matin.

sw.L: Na nyama ya dhabihu ya shukrani ya sadaka zake za amani italiwa siku ya sadaka yake; hataacha kitu chochote hadi asubuhi.
sw.B: Nyama ya sadaka ya amani iliyotolewa kwa shukrani italiwa siku ileile inapotolewa. Hakuna chochote kitakachobakizwa hadi asubuhi inayofuata.
sw.R: Nyama ya sadaka ya shukrani lazima iliwe siku ileile inapotolewa. Usibakize chochote hadi asubuhi inayofuata.

ko.L: 그리고 자기 화목제의 감사의 희생 제물의 고기는 그 제물을 바치는 날에 먹어야 한다. 그는 그것을 조금도 아침까지 남겨 두면 안 된다.
ko.B: 감사의 뜻으로 바친 화목제물의 고기는 바친 그날에 먹어야 한다. 그 고기를 조금이라도 다음 날 아침까지 남겨 두어서는 안 된다.
ko.R: 감사의 뜻으로 바친 제물의 고기는 바친 그날에 먹어야 한다. 그 고기를 조금도 다음 날 아침까지 남겨 두면 안 된다.

vi.L: Và thịt của sinh tế tạ ơn của các tế lễ bình an của người ấy phải được ăn trong ngày dâng; người ấy không được để lại chút nào cho đến sáng.
vi.B: Thịt của tế lễ bình an dâng để tạ ơn phải được ăn ngay trong ngày dâng. Không được để lại chút nào đến sáng hôm sau.
vi.R: Thịt của tế lễ tạ ơn phải được ăn ngay trong ngày dâng. Đừng để lại chút nào đến sáng hôm sau.

pt.L: E a carne do sacrifício de ação de graças dos seus sacrifícios de comunhão será comida no dia da sua oferta; não deixará nada dela até a manhã.
pt.B: A carne do sacrifício de comunhão oferecido em ação de graças será comida no mesmo dia em que for oferecido. Nada dela será guardado até a manhã seguinte.
pt.R: A carne da oferta de agradecimento deve ser comida no mesmo dia em que for oferecida. Não guardes nada dela até a manhã seguinte.

am.L: የኅብረት መሥዋዕቱ የምስጋና መሥዋዕት ሥጋ በሚያቀርብበት ቀን ይበላል፤ ከእርሱም ምንም እስከ ጠዋት አያስቀርም።
am.B: ለምስጋና የቀረበው የኅብረት መሥዋዕት ሥጋ በቀረበበት ቀን ይበላ። ከእርሱ ምንም ነገር እስከ ማግሥቱ ጠዋት አይቆይ።
am.R: የምስጋናው መሥዋዕት ሥጋ በቀረበበት ቀን መበላት አለበት። ከእርሱ ምንም ነገር እስከ ማግሥቱ ጠዋት አታስቀር።

hi.L: और उसकी मेलबलियों के धन्यवाद के बलिदान का मांस उसके चढ़ावे के दिन ही खाया जाए; वह उसमें से कुछ भी भोर तक न छोड़े।
hi.B: धन्यवाद की मेलबलि का मांस उसी दिन खाया जाए जिस दिन वह चढ़ाई जाए। उसमें से कुछ भी अगली भोर तक न रखा जाए।
hi.R: धन्यवाद की मेलबलि का मांस उसी दिन खाना होगा जिस दिन वह चढ़ाई जाए। उसमें से कुछ भी अगली सुबह तक न रखना।

ru.L: А мясо мирной жертвы благодарения его в день приношения его пусть съедят; пусть не оставляет он от него до утра.
ru.B: Мясо мирной жертвы, принесённой в благодарность, нужно съесть в тот же день, когда её принесли. Ничего нельзя оставлять до следующего утра.
ru.R: Мясо жертвы благодарения нужно съесть в тот же день, когда её принесли. Ничего не оставляйте до следующего утра.

ja.L: そして和解の感謝のいけにえの肉は、そのささげ物の日に食べられなければならない。彼はそのうちの何も朝まで残してはならない。
ja.B: 感謝のためにささげた交わりのいけにえの肉は、それをささげた日のうちに食べなければならない。その一部でも翌朝まで残しておいてはならない。
ja.R: 感謝の交わりのいけにえの肉は、それをささげた日のうちに食べなければならない。少しでも次の朝まで残しておいてはいけない。

uk.L: А мʼясо його мирної жертви подяки їстимуть у день його жертви; він не залишить із нього нічого до ранку.
uk.B: Мʼясо мирної жертви, принесеної на подяку, треба зʼїсти того самого дня, коли її принесли. Нічого з нього не можна залишати до ранку.
uk.R: Мʼясо жертви подяки треба зʼїсти того самого дня, коли її принесли. Не залишайте нічого з нього до наступного ранку.

decisions.choice: on the day of his offering ... not until morning: one day only
decisions.reason: The meat of a thanksgiving must be finished the same day, as with the Passover lamb (Exodus 12:10) and the ordination ram (Exodus 29:34). The vow and freewill offerings allow two days (verse 16). What remains is burned (compare 7:17).

decisions.choice: he will not leave: the worshiper and those who share the meal
decisions.reason: The worshiper is responsible for seeing that the meal is eaten in the time allowed. The meal could be shared with family and guests who were clean (verse 19).

decisions.choice: Nothing of it is to be kept (Balanced); Do not keep (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced uses a passive and Readable speaks to the reader, so that neither needs "he" for a worshiper who may be a man or a woman.

source.text: וְאִם־נֶ֣דֶר׀א֣וֹ נְדָבָ֗ה זֶ֚בַח קָרְבָּנ֔וֹ בְּי֛וֹם הַקְרִיב֥וֹ אֶת־זִבְח֖וֹ יֵאָכֵ֑ל וּמִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וְהַנּוֹתָ֥ר מִמֶּ֖נּוּ יֵאָכֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And if [is] a vow or a freewill offering the sacrifice of his present, on the day he presents his sacrifice it will be eaten, and from [the] next day the remainder of it will be eaten.

en.L: And if the sacrifice of his offering [is] a vow or a freewill offering, on the day he brings near his sacrifice it shall be eaten, and on the next day what remains of it may be eaten.
en.B: If the sacrifice is offered to fulfill a vow, or as a freewill offering, it is to be eaten on the day it is presented, and the rest may still be eaten the following day.
en.R: Someone may bring a peace offering to keep a promise they made to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, or simply because they want to give it. Then the meat may be eaten on the day it is offered. What is left may also be eaten the next day.

es.L: Y si el sacrificio de su ofrenda [es] un voto o una ofrenda voluntaria, el día en que presente su sacrificio se comerá, y al día siguiente se podrá comer lo que quede de él.
es.B: Si el sacrificio se ofrece para cumplir un voto o como ofrenda voluntaria, se comerá el día en que se presente, y lo que sobre se podrá comer todavía al día siguiente.
es.R: Alguien puede traer un sacrificio de paz para cumplir una promesa que le hizo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, o simplemente porque quiere darlo. Entonces la carne puede comerse el día en que se ofrece. Lo que sobre también puede comerse al día siguiente.

fr.L: Et si le sacrifice de son offrande [est] un vœu ou une offrande volontaire, il sera mangé le jour où il fera approcher son sacrifice, et le lendemain ce qui en reste pourra être mangé.
fr.B: Si le sacrifice est offert pour accomplir un vœu, ou comme offrande volontaire, on le mangera le jour où on le présente, et le reste pourra encore être mangé le lendemain.
fr.R: Quelqu’un peut apporter un sacrifice de communion pour tenir une promesse faite {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, ou simplement parce qu’il a envie de le donner. Alors la viande peut être mangée le jour où elle est offerte. Ce qui reste peut aussi être mangé le lendemain.

sw.L: Na ikiwa dhabihu ya sadaka yake [ni] nadhiri au sadaka ya hiari, italiwa siku atakapoisogeza dhabihu yake, na kesho yake kinachobaki kitaweza kuliwa.
sw.B: Ikiwa dhabihu hiyo inatolewa kutimiza nadhiri, au kuwa sadaka ya hiari, italiwa siku inapotolewa, na kinachobaki kinaweza kuliwa siku inayofuata.
sw.R: Mtu anaweza kuleta sadaka ya amani ili kutimiza ahadi aliyomwahidi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, au kwa sababu tu anataka kuitoa. Hapo nyama inaweza kuliwa siku ile inapotolewa. Inayobaki inaweza pia kuliwa siku inayofuata.

ko.L: 그리고 만일 그의 희생 제물이 서원이나 자원 제물이면, 그것은 그가 자기 희생 제물을 가까이 바치는 날에 먹어야 하고, 그 이튿날에도 그 남은 것을 먹을 수 있다.
ko.B: 서원을 지키려고 바치거나 스스로 원해서 바치는 희생 제물이면, 그것을 바친 날에 먹어야 하고, 남은 것은 이튿날에도 먹을 수 있다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 약속한 것을 지키려고 화목제물을 바치거나, 그냥 드리고 싶어서 바칠 수도 있다. 그때에는 그 고기를 바친 날에 먹어도 되고, 남은 것은 이튿날에 먹어도 된다.

vi.L: Và nếu sinh tế của lễ vật người ấy [là] một lời khấn nguyện hoặc một lễ vật tự nguyện, thì nó phải được ăn trong ngày người ấy dâng sinh tế mình, và phần còn lại có thể được ăn vào ngày hôm sau.
vi.B: Nếu sinh tế được dâng để trả lời khấn nguyện, hoặc làm lễ vật tự nguyện, thì phải ăn trong ngày dâng, và phần còn lại vẫn có thể ăn vào ngày hôm sau.
vi.R: Có người dâng tế lễ bình an để giữ lời mình đã hứa với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hoặc chỉ vì muốn dâng. Khi đó thịt có thể được ăn trong ngày dâng. Phần còn lại cũng có thể được ăn vào ngày hôm sau.

pt.L: E se o sacrifício da sua oferta [for] um voto ou uma oferta voluntária, no dia em que oferecer o seu sacrifício será comido, e no dia seguinte o que sobrar dele [ainda] poderá ser comido.
pt.B: Se o sacrifício for oferecido para cumprir um voto, ou como oferta voluntária, será comido no dia em que for apresentado, e o que sobrar ainda poderá ser comido no dia seguinte.
pt.R: Alguém pode trazer um sacrifício de comunhão para cumprir uma promessa que fez {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, ou simplesmente porque quer dar. Nesse caso, a carne pode ser comida no dia em que for oferecida. O que sobrar também pode ser comido no dia seguinte.

am.L: የመባውም መሥዋዕት ስእለት ወይም የፈቃድ መሥዋዕት ቢሆን፣ መሥዋዕቱን በሚያቀርብበት ቀን ይበላል፤ የቀረውም በማግሥቱ ይበላል።
am.B: መሥዋዕቱ ስእለትን ለመፈጸም ወይም የፈቃድ መሥዋዕት ቢሆን፣ በቀረበበት ቀን ይበላ፤ የቀረውም በማግሥቱ ሊበላ ይችላል።
am.R: አንድ ሰው {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} የገባውን ቃል ለመፈጸም ወይም ደግሞ መስጠት ስለ ፈለገ ብቻ የኅብረት መሥዋዕት ሊያመጣ ይችላል። እንዲህ ከሆነ ሥጋው በቀረበበት ቀን ሊበላ ይችላል። የተረፈውም በማግሥቱ ሊበላ ይችላል።

hi.L: और यदि उसके चढ़ावे का बलिदान मन्नत या स्वेच्छा की भेंट [हो], तो जिस दिन वह अपना बलिदान निकट लाए उसी दिन वह खाया जाए, और अगले दिन भी उसमें से जो बचे वह खाया जा सकता है।
hi.B: यदि बलिदान किसी मन्नत को पूरा करने के लिए या स्वेच्छा की भेंट के रूप में चढ़ाया जाए, तो वह उसी दिन खाया जाए जिस दिन वह चढ़ाया जाए, और जो बचे वह अगले दिन भी खाया जा सकता है।
hi.R: कोई {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से किया हुआ वादा पूरा करने के लिए, या बस अपनी इच्छा से देने के लिए, मेलबलि ला सकता है। तब उसका मांस उसी दिन खाया जा सकता है जिस दिन वह चढ़ाई जाए। जो बचे वह अगले दिन भी खाया जा सकता है।

ru.L: А если по обету или добровольная жертва — приношение его, в день, когда он приносит жертву свою, пусть съедят её, и на другой день остаток её можно есть.
ru.B: Если жертву приносят по обету или как добровольное приношение, её нужно есть в день принесения, а остаток можно есть и на следующий день.
ru.R: Человек может принести мирную жертву, чтобы исполнить обещание, которое он дал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, или просто потому, что хочет её принести. Тогда мясо можно есть в тот день, когда принесена жертва. То, что останется, можно есть и на следующий день.

ja.L: そしてもし、そのささげ物のいけにえが誓願、あるいは自発のささげ物であるなら、それは彼がいけにえをささげる日に食べられ、その残りは翌日にも食べてよい。
ja.B: そのいけにえが誓願を果たすため、あるいは自発のささげ物としてささげられる場合は、ささげた日に食べ、残りは翌日に食べてもよい。
ja.R: 人は、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に約束したことを果たすために、あるいは、ただささげたいと思って、交わりのいけにえを持って来ることもある。そのときは、その肉をささげた日に食べてよい。残ったものは、次の日に食べてもよい。

uk.L: А якщо жертва його приношення — обітниця або добровільна жертва, у день, коли він піднесе свою жертву, її їстимуть, а наступного дня можна їсти й те, що з неї залишиться.
uk.B: Якщо жертву приносять, щоб виконати обітницю, або як добровільну жертву, її треба їсти в день, коли її піднесли, а решту можна їсти й наступного дня.
uk.R: Хтось може принести мирну жертву, щоб виконати обіцянку, яку дав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, або просто тому, що хоче її дати. Тоді мʼясо можна їсти в день, коли жертву принесли. Те, що залишиться, можна їсти й наступного дня.

decisions.choice: a vow: an offering promised to God and now paid
decisions.reason: A vow is a solemn promise to give God something, often made in a time of need and paid when the prayer has been answered (Genesis 28:20-22; 1 Samuel 1:11, 24-28; Psalm 66:13-14). Once made, it must be kept (Deuteronomy 23:21-23; Ecclesiastes 5:4-5). The peace offering is one way of paying it (22:21; Numbers 15:8). Chapter 27 deals with vows of persons and property.

decisions.choice: a freewill offering: given of one's own accord
decisions.reason: The word comes from a verb meaning to be willing or moved to give. It is not owed for any sin and not promised in advance: the worshiper simply chooses to give it (22:18, 21, 23; Exodus 35:29; Deuteronomy 16:10). Lesser animals were acceptable for it than for a vow (22:23).

decisions.choice: on the next day: two days for these offerings
decisions.reason: The thanksgiving must be eaten on the day it is offered (verse 15); the vow and freewill offerings may be eaten over two days. The meat must not reach the third day (verses 17-18).

decisions.choice: to keep a promise they made to the LORD, or simply because they want to give it
decisions.reason: Readable explains the two terms by what each offering is for.

decisions.choice: "un voto"; "una ofrenda voluntaria"
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the names of the two offerings: "voto" for a gift promised to God and now paid, "ofrenda voluntaria" for one given freely. Readable explains them, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "un vœu"; "une offrande volontaire"
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the names of the two offerings: "vœu" for a gift promised to God and now paid, "offrande volontaire" for one given freely. Readable explains them, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "nadhiri"; "sadaka ya hiari"
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the names of the two offerings: "nadhiri" for a gift promised to God and now paid, "sadaka ya hiari" for one given freely. Readable explains them with "ahadi" (a promise), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "서원" for the vow and "자원 제물" / "스스로 원해서 바치는" for the freewill offering
decisions.reason: "서원" is in the term sheet; for the freewill offering Literal keeps a short name, Balanced describes it, avoiding the older "낙헌제".

decisions.choice: "lời khấn nguyện" for a vow; "lễ vật tự nguyện" for a freewill offering; Readable explains both
decisions.reason: "lời khấn nguyện" is the Pentateuch sheet's word for a vow; "tự nguyện" says plainly that the gift is given of one's own accord.

decisions.choice: um voto; uma oferta voluntária
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "voto" is the solemn promise to give God something (m1), the word Portuguese uses for it; "oferta voluntária" says that it is given of one's own accord (m2). Readable explains both by what they are for, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "ስእለት" (vow); "የፈቃድ መሥዋዕት" (freewill offering, L, B)
decisions.reason: "ስእለት" is the word settled in Genesis for a vow (m1); the freewill offering is given of one's own accord (m2). Readable explains both, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "मन्नत" (a vow); "स्वेच्छा की भेंट" (a freewill offering)
decisions.reason: A vow is an offering promised to God and now paid (m1); a freewill offering is given of one's own accord (m2). "स्वेच्छा की भेंट" is the form of Exodus. Readable explains both, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "по обету"; "добровольная жертва" (L), "добровольное приношение" (B); explained at R
decisions.reason: A vow offering pays what was promised to God (m1); a freewill offering is given of one's own accord (m2). Readable explains both, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: neder "誓願" (L, B), nedavah "自発のささげ物" (L, B); Readable explains both
decisions.reason: An offering promised to God and now paid, and one given of one's own accord (meaning decisions m1, m2); the forms of Genesis 28:20 and Exodus 35:29.

decisions.choice: "обітниця" (Literal, Balanced), "обіцянка" (Readable); "добровільна жертва" for the freewill offering
decisions.reason: Follows the New Testament books' "обітниця / обіцянка" split between levels; "добровільна" says plainly that the gift is not required. Book-wide choice.

source.text: וְהַנּוֹתָ֖ר מִבְּשַׂ֣ר הַזָּ֑בַח בַּיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י בָּאֵ֖שׁ יִשָּׂרֵֽף׃

records.literal_gloss: And the remainder of the meat of the sacrifice on the third day with fire it will be burned.

en.L: And what remains of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.
en.B: But any meat from the sacrifice still left on the third day must be burned up.
en.R: Any meat still left on the third day must be burned up.

es.L: Y lo que quede de la carne del sacrificio al tercer día será quemado en el fuego.
es.B: Pero la carne del sacrificio que todavía quede al tercer día se quemará del todo.
es.R: Toda la carne que quede al tercer día tiene que quemarse.

fr.L: Et ce qui reste de la chair du sacrifice le troisième jour sera brûlé au feu.
fr.B: Mais toute la viande du sacrifice qui restera le troisième jour sera entièrement brûlée.
fr.R: Toute la viande qui reste le troisième jour doit être brûlée.

sw.L: Na kinachobaki cha nyama ya dhabihu siku ya tatu kitachomwa kwa moto.
sw.B: Lakini nyama yoyote ya dhabihu itakayobaki hadi siku ya tatu itachomwa kabisa.
sw.R: Nyama yoyote itakayobaki hadi siku ya tatu lazima ichomwe moto.

ko.L: 그리고 그 희생 제물의 고기 가운데 사흘째까지 남은 것은 불로 태워야 한다.
ko.B: 그러나 희생 제물의 고기가 사흘째 되는 날까지 남아 있으면 불에 태워야 한다.
ko.R: 사흘째 되는 날까지 남은 고기는 불에 다 태워야 한다.

vi.L: Và phần còn lại của thịt sinh tế vào ngày thứ ba phải bị đốt trong lửa.
vi.B: Nhưng thịt sinh tế nào còn lại đến ngày thứ ba thì phải đốt hết.
vi.R: Thịt nào còn lại đến ngày thứ ba phải đốt hết.

pt.L: E o que sobrar da carne do sacrifício no terceiro dia será queimado no fogo.
pt.B: Mas a carne do sacrifício que ainda sobrar no terceiro dia será toda queimada.
pt.R: Qualquer carne que ainda sobrar no terceiro dia deve ser toda queimada.

am.L: ከመሥዋዕቱም ሥጋ የቀረው በሦስተኛው ቀን በእሳት ይቃጠላል።
am.B: ነገር ግን ከመሥዋዕቱ ሥጋ እስከ ሦስተኛው ቀን የቀረ ቢኖር በእሳት ይቃጠል።
am.R: እስከ ሦስተኛው ቀን የተረፈ ሥጋ ሁሉ መቃጠል አለበት።

hi.L: और बलिदान के मांस में से जो तीसरे दिन तक बचे वह आग में जला दिया जाए।
hi.B: पर बलिदान का जो मांस तीसरे दिन तक बचा रहे, वह पूरी तरह जला दिया जाए।
hi.R: जो मांस तीसरे दिन तक बचा रहे, उसे पूरी तरह जला देना होगा।

ru.L: А остаток мяса жертвы на третий день пусть будет сожжён на огне.
ru.B: Но мясо жертвы, которое останется до третьего дня, нужно сжечь.
ru.R: Мясо, которое останется до третьего дня, нужно сжечь.

ja.L: しかし、いけにえの肉の残りは、三日目には火で焼かれなければならない。
ja.B: しかし、いけにえの肉が三日目まで残っていたら、それは焼き捨てなければならない。
ja.R: 三日目まで残った肉は、焼いてしまわなければならない。

uk.L: А те, що залишиться з мʼяса жертви на третій день, спалять у вогні.
uk.B: Але мʼясо жертви, що залишиться до третього дня, треба спалити.
uk.R: Мʼясо, яке ще залишиться на третій день, треба спалити.

decisions.choice: burned: destroyed by fire
decisions.reason: This is the ordinary verb for burning, as in 6:23, not the verb for making an offering smoke on the altar. The leftover meat is destroyed so that it cannot be eaten (19:6).

source.text: וְאִ֣ם הֵאָכֹ֣ל יֵ֠אָכֵל מִבְּשַׂר־זֶ֨בַח שְׁלָמָ֜יו בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי֮ לֹ֣א יֵרָצֶה֒ הַמַּקְרִ֣יב אֹת֗וֹ לֹ֧א יֵחָשֵׁ֛ב ל֖וֹ פִּגּ֣וּל יִהְיֶ֑ה וְהַנֶּ֛פֶשׁ הָאֹכֶ֥לֶת מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עֲוֺנָ֥הּ תִּשָּֽׂא׃

records.literal_gloss: And if ever it is eaten any of the meat of the sacrifice of his peace offerings on the third day, not will be accepted the [one who] presented it; not it will be reckoned to him; foul meat it will be, and the person [who] eats of it its iniquity will bear.

en.L: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is indeed eaten on the third day, the one who brought it near will not be accepted; it will not be counted to him; it will be foul [meat], and the person who eats of it will bear the iniquity.
en.B: Should any meat of the peace offering be eaten on the third day, the one who brought it will not be accepted, and the offering will not count in their favor. It is foul meat, and whoever eats any of it will bear the guilt.
en.R: If any meat from the peace offering is eaten on the third day, the person who brought the offering will not be accepted. The offering will do them no good. That meat has gone bad. Anyone who eats it will have to suffer for their sin.

es.L: Y si de veras se come algo de la carne del sacrificio de su sacrificio de paz al tercer día, el que lo presentó no será aceptado; no le será tomado en cuenta; será [carne] corrompida, y la persona que coma de ella llevará la iniquidad.
es.B: Si se come algo de la carne del sacrificio de paz al tercer día, el que lo trajo no será aceptado, y la ofrenda no contará a su favor. Es carne corrompida, y quien coma de ella cargará con su culpa.
es.R: Si alguien come carne del sacrificio de paz al tercer día, la persona que trajo la ofrenda no será aceptada. La ofrenda no le servirá de nada. Esa carne se ha echado a perder. Quien la coma tendrá que sufrir por su pecado.

fr.L: Et si l’on mange vraiment de la chair du sacrifice de son sacrifice de communion le troisième jour, celui qui l’a fait approcher ne sera pas agréé ; cela ne lui sera pas compté ; ce sera une [viande] infecte, et la personne qui en mange portera la faute.
fr.B: Si l’on mange de la viande du sacrifice de communion le troisième jour, celui qui l’a apporté ne sera pas agréé, et l’offrande ne comptera pas en sa faveur. C’est de la viande infecte, et celui qui en mangera portera le poids de sa faute.
fr.R: Si quelqu’un mange de la viande du sacrifice de communion le troisième jour, la personne qui a apporté l’offrande ne sera pas acceptée. L’offrande ne lui servira à rien. Cette viande est devenue mauvaise. Celui qui en mange devra subir les conséquences de son péché.

sw.L: Na ikiwa nyama yoyote ya dhabihu ya sadaka zake za amani italiwa kweli siku ya tatu, yeye aliyeisogeza hatakubaliwa; haitahesabiwa kwake; itakuwa [nyama] iliyochafuka, na mtu atakayekula katika hiyo atachukua uovu.
sw.B: Nyama yoyote ya sadaka ya amani ikiliwa siku ya tatu, aliyeileta hatakubaliwa, wala sadaka hiyo haitahesabiwa kwa faida yake. Ni nyama iliyoharibika, na yeyote atakayekula sehemu yake atabeba hatia yake.
sw.R: Nyama ya sadaka ya amani ikiliwa siku ya tatu, mtu aliyeleta sadaka hiyo hatakubaliwa. Sadaka hiyo haitamfaa kitu. Nyama hiyo imeharibika. Yeyote atakayeila ataadhibiwa kwa dhambi yake.

ko.L: 그리고 만일 그의 화목제의 희생 제물의 고기를 사흘째 되는 날에 조금이라도 먹으면, 그것을 가까이 바친 사람은 받아들여지지 않을 것이고, 그것이 그에게 인정되지 않을 것이다. 그것은 혐오스러운 [고기]가 될 것이고, 그것을 먹는 사람은 죄악을 짊어질 것이다.
ko.B: 화목제물의 고기를 사흘째 되는 날에 조금이라도 먹으면, 그것을 바친 사람은 받아들여지지 않고, 그 제물은 그에게 아무 효력이 없다. 그것은 혐오스러운 고기이니, 그것을 먹는 사람은 누구든지 죄책을 짊어질 것이다.
ko.R: 화목제물의 고기를 사흘째 되는 날에 먹으면, 그 제물을 바친 사람은 받아들여지지 않는다. 그 제물은 그에게 아무 소용이 없다. 그 고기는 상한 것이다. 그것을 먹는 사람은 자기 죄의 벌을 받아야 한다.

vi.L: Và nếu có chút thịt nào của sinh tế bình an của người ấy thật được ăn vào ngày thứ ba, thì người đã dâng nó sẽ không được chấp nhận; nó sẽ không được kể cho người ấy; nó sẽ là [thịt] ôi, và người nào ăn nó sẽ mang lấy sự gian ác.
vi.B: Nếu có ai ăn thịt của tế lễ bình an vào ngày thứ ba, thì người đã dâng sẽ không được chấp nhận, và lễ vật ấy sẽ không được kể là có ích cho người ấy. Đó là thịt ôi, và ai ăn thịt ấy sẽ gánh chịu tội lỗi mình.
vi.R: Nếu thịt của tế lễ bình an bị ăn vào ngày thứ ba, thì người đã dâng lễ vật sẽ không được chấp nhận. Lễ vật ấy sẽ chẳng ích gì cho người ấy. Thịt ấy đã hư. Ai ăn thịt ấy sẽ phải chịu hình phạt vì tội mình.

pt.L: E se de fato for comida alguma carne do sacrifício dos seus sacrifícios de comunhão no terceiro dia, aquele que o ofereceu não será aceito; não lhe será creditado; será coisa abominável, e a pessoa que dela comer levará a sua iniquidade.
pt.B: Se alguma carne do sacrifício de comunhão for comida no terceiro dia, quem o ofereceu não será aceito, e a oferta não contará a seu favor. É carne repugnante, e quem dela comer carregará a culpa.
pt.R: Se alguma carne do sacrifício de comunhão for comida no terceiro dia, a pessoa que trouxe a oferta não será aceita. A oferta não vai lhe fazer nenhum bem. Essa carne já está estragada. Quem a comer vai sofrer as consequências do seu pecado.

am.L: ከኅብረት መሥዋዕቱም ሥጋ በሦስተኛው ቀን ቢበላ፣ ያቀረበው ተቀባይነት አያገኝም፤ አይቆጠርለትም፤ የሚያስጸይፍ [ሥጋ] ይሆናል፤ ከእርሱም የሚበላ ሰው በደሉን ይሸከማል።
am.B: ከኅብረት መሥዋዕቱ ሥጋ በሦስተኛው ቀን ቢበላ፣ ያቀረበው ሰው ተቀባይነት አያገኝም፤ መሥዋዕቱም አይቆጠርለትም። የሚያስጸይፍ ሥጋ ነው፤ ከእርሱም የሚበላ ሰው በደሉን ይሸከማል።
am.R: ከኅብረት መሥዋዕቱ ሥጋ በሦስተኛው ቀን ቢበላ፣ መሥዋዕቱን ያመጣው ሰው ተቀባይነት አያገኝም። መሥዋዕቱ ምንም አይጠቅመውም። ያ ሥጋ ተበላሽቷል። የሚበላውም ሰው ስለ ኃጢአቱ ቅጣት ይቀበላል።

hi.L: और यदि उसकी मेलबलियों के बलिदान के मांस में से कुछ तीसरे दिन सचमुच खाया जाए, तो जिसने उसे निकट लाया वह ग्रहण न किया जाएगा; वह उसके [हित में] न गिना जाएगा; वह घिनौना [मांस] होगा, और जो प्राणी उसमें से खाए वह अधर्म का भार उठाएगा।
hi.B: यदि मेलबलि का कुछ मांस तीसरे दिन खाया जाए, तो चढ़ानेवाला ग्रहण न किया जाएगा, और वह चढ़ावा उसके हित में न गिना जाएगा। वह घिनौना मांस है, और जो कोई उसमें से कुछ खाए वह अपने दोष का भार उठाएगा।
hi.R: यदि मेलबलि का कोई मांस तीसरे दिन खाया जाए, तो चढ़ानेवाला व्यक्ति ग्रहण न किया जाएगा। उस चढ़ावे से उसे कोई लाभ न होगा। वह मांस बिगड़ चुका है। जो कोई उसे खाए उसे अपने पाप का फल भुगतना होगा।

ru.L: И если всё же будет съедено что-либо из мяса мирной жертвы его на третий день, не будет принят принёсший её; не вменится ему; мерзостью будет это, и душа, которая съест от него, понесёт беззаконие своё.
ru.B: Если мясо мирной жертвы съедят на третий день, тот, кто её принёс, не будет принят, и жертва не будет засчитана ему. Это негодное мясо, и тот, кто его съест, понесёт свою вину.
ru.R: Если мясо мирной жертвы съедят на третий день, человек, который принёс жертву, не будет принят. Его жертва не принесёт ему никакой пользы. Это мясо испортилось. Тот, кто его съест, понесёт наказание за свой грех.

ja.L: そしてもし、和解のいけにえの肉が三日目に少しでも食べられるなら、それをささげた者は受け入れられない。それは彼のものと認められない。それは忌むべき[肉]となり、それを食べる者はその咎を負う。
ja.B: 交わりのいけにえの肉が三日目に少しでも食べられたなら、それをささげた人は受け入れられず、そのささげ物はその人のためにならない。それは忌むべき肉であり、それを食べる者は咎を負う。
ja.R: 交わりのいけにえの肉が三日目に食べられるなら、それを持って来た人は受け入れられない。そのささげ物は、その人のために何の役にも立たない。その肉はもう腐っている。それを食べる人は、自分の罪のために罰を受けなければならない。

uk.L: А якщо справді їстимуть з мʼяса його мирної жертви на третій день, не буде прийнятий той, хто її підніс; не зарахується йому; гидотою це буде, і людина, яка їстиме з нього, понесе беззаконня.
uk.B: Якщо мʼясо мирної жертви їстимуть на третій день, того, хто її приніс, не буде прийнято, і жертва не зарахується йому. Це огидне мʼясо, і кожен, хто його їстиме, нестиме провину.
uk.R: Якщо мʼясо мирної жертви їдять на третій день, людину, яка принесла жертву, не буде прийнято. Жертва не принесе їй жодної користі. Це мʼясо вже зіпсувалося. Кожен, хто його їсть, мусить нести покарання за свій гріх.

decisions.choice: not accepted, not reckoned to him: the whole offering loses its value
decisions.reason: To be "accepted" is the purpose of every offering (1:3-4). Eating the meat too late undoes that: the offering is not credited to the worshiper. The same words are used of the sacrifice in 19:7.

decisions.choice: foul meat: spoiled sacrificial meat
decisions.reason: The word is used only of sacrificial meat kept too long (19:7) or of unclean food (Ezekiel 4:14; Isaiah 65:4). It means a disgusting thing, unfit for God and for people.

decisions.choice: bear its iniquity: be held guilty and liable to punishment
decisions.reason: To bear iniquity is to carry the guilt of a wrong and its consequences (5:1, 17). The one who eats, not only the one who offered, is held guilty.

decisions.choice: the iniquity
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "her iniquity", the pronoun agreeing with the feminine word for "person". Literal says "the iniquity" so as not to suggest that a woman is meant; compare 17:10.

decisions.choice: That meat has gone bad; will have to suffer for their sin
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "foul" and "bear the iniquity" mean.

decisions.choice: "[carne] corrompida" (L); "carne corrompida" (B)
decisions.reason: The word is used of sacrificial meat kept too long. "Corrompida" says that it has become unfit, without the older "abominación", which reads as a moral word.

decisions.choice: "[viande] infecte" (L); "viande infecte" (B)
decisions.reason: The word is used of sacrificial meat kept too long. "Infecte" says that it has become foul and unfit, without the older "abomination", which reads as a moral word.

decisions.choice: "[nyama] iliyochafuka" (L); "nyama iliyoharibika" (B)
decisions.reason: The word is used of sacrificial meat kept too long. Literal says it has become foul, Balanced that it is spoiled; "chukizo" is kept for the "detestable thing" of verse 21.

decisions.choice: "혐오스러운 [고기]" for "foul meat"; Readable "상한 것"
decisions.reason: The word names sacrificial meat that has become unfit, spoiled and offensive; "가증하다" is the older church word and suggests moral abomination.

decisions.choice: "[thịt] ôi" (Literal), "thịt ôi" (Balanced), "thịt ấy đã hư" (Readable) for foul meat
decisions.reason: The word means sacrificial meat that has spoiled; "ôi" is the everyday word for meat gone bad, and Readable says it more plainly still.

decisions.choice: coisa abominável (L), carne repugnante (B), já está estragada (R); levará a sua iniquidade (L)
decisions.reason: The word names sacrificial meat kept too long, a disgusting thing (m2): "coisa abominável" (L) and "carne repugnante" (B); Readable says what has happened to it, as the English does. The English Literal says "the iniquity" to avoid "her"; Portuguese "a pessoa ... a sua iniquidade" agrees with "pessoa" and does not suggest a woman, so Literal can keep the possessive.

decisions.choice: "የሚያስጸይፍ ሥጋ" (foul meat, L, B); "ተበላሽቷል" (has gone bad, R)
decisions.reason: Sacrificial meat kept too long becomes spoiled and repulsive (m2); Readable says it "has gone bad", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "घिनौना [मांस]" (L); "घिनौना मांस" (B); "वह मांस बिगड़ चुका है" (R)
decisions.reason: Spoiled sacrificial meat (m2), a word distinct from "unclean", so Hindi does not say "अशुद्ध". Readable says it has gone bad, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "мерзость" (L); "негодное мясо" (B); "мясо испортилось" (R)
decisions.reason: The word means spoiled sacrificial meat, unfit and offensive (m2). Literal keeps a strong word; Balanced and Readable say what it is, as the English does.

decisions.choice: piggul "忌むべき[肉]" (L), "忌むべき肉" (B), "もう腐っている" (R)
decisions.reason: Spoiled sacrificial meat (meaning decision m2); 忌むべき keeps it apart from tame "汚れた"; Readable follows the English Readable "has gone bad".

decisions.choice: "гидота" (Literal), "огидне мʼясо" (Balanced), "мʼясо вже зіпсувалося" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word is a technical term for sacrificial meat that has become unfit; each level follows the English level's wording.

source.text: וְהַבָּשָׂ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־יִגַּ֤ע בְּכָל־טָמֵא֙ לֹ֣א יֵֽאָכֵ֔ל בָּאֵ֖שׁ יִשָּׂרֵ֑ף וְהַ֨בָּשָׂ֔ר כָּל־טָה֖וֹר יֹאכַ֥ל בָּשָֽׂר׃

records.literal_gloss: And the meat which touches any unclean [thing] not will be eaten; with fire it will be burned; and the meat, every clean [person] will eat meat.

en.L: And the flesh that touches anything unclean shall not be eaten; it shall be burned with fire. And [as for] the flesh, everyone who is clean may eat [the] flesh.
en.B: If the meat comes into contact with anything unclean, no one may eat it; it must be burned in the fire. Otherwise, the meat may be eaten by anyone who is clean.
en.R: If the meat touches anything unclean, it must not be eaten. It must be burned up. Anyone who is clean may eat the rest of the meat.

es.L: Y la carne que toque cualquier cosa impura no se comerá; será quemada en el fuego. Y [en cuanto a] la carne, todo el que esté puro podrá comer [la] carne.
es.B: Si la carne entra en contacto con algo impuro, nadie podrá comerla; se quemará en el fuego. Por lo demás, cualquiera que esté puro podrá comer la carne.
es.R: Si la carne toca algo impuro, no se debe comer. Tiene que quemarse. Cualquiera que esté puro puede comer el resto de la carne.

fr.L: Et la chair qui touche quoi que ce soit d’impur ne sera pas mangée ; elle sera brûlée au feu. Et [quant à] la chair, quiconque est pur pourra manger [de la] chair.
fr.B: Si la viande touche quelque chose d’impur, on ne la mangera pas ; elle sera brûlée au feu. Sinon, la viande pourra être mangée par toute personne pure.
fr.R: Si la viande touche quelque chose d’impur, il ne faut pas la manger. Elle doit être brûlée. Toute personne pure peut manger le reste de la viande.

sw.L: Na nyama itakayogusa kitu chochote najisi haitaliwa; itachomwa kwa moto. Na [kuhusu] nyama, kila aliye safi atakula nyama.
sw.B: Nyama ikigusana na kitu chochote najisi, mtu yeyote asiile; itachomwa motoni. Vinginevyo, nyama hiyo inaweza kuliwa na yeyote aliye safi.
sw.R: Nyama ikigusa kitu najisi, isiliwe. Lazima ichomwe moto. Mtu yeyote aliye safi anaweza kula nyama inayobaki.

ko.L: 그리고 부정한 것에 닿은 고기는 먹으면 안 된다. 그것은 불로 태워야 한다. 그리고 [그 밖의] 고기는 정결한 사람은 누구나 그 고기를 먹을 수 있다.
ko.B: 고기가 부정한 것에 닿았으면 아무도 그것을 먹어서는 안 되고, 불에 태워야 한다. 그렇지 않은 고기는 정결한 사람이면 누구나 먹을 수 있다.
ko.R: 고기가 부정한 것에 닿았으면 그것을 먹으면 안 된다. 그것은 불에 태워야 한다. 나머지 고기는 정결한 사람이면 누구나 먹어도 된다.

vi.L: Và thịt chạm vào bất cứ vật gì ô uế thì không được ăn; nó phải bị đốt trong lửa. Còn [về] thịt, mọi người tinh sạch đều có thể ăn thịt.
vi.B: Nếu thịt chạm vào bất cứ vật gì ô uế thì không ai được ăn; phải đốt nó trong lửa. Ngoài ra, bất cứ ai tinh sạch đều có thể ăn thịt ấy.
vi.R: Nếu thịt chạm vào vật gì ô uế, thì không được ăn. Phải đốt hết. Bất cứ ai tinh sạch đều có thể ăn phần thịt còn lại.

pt.L: E a carne que tocar qualquer coisa impura não será comida; será queimada no fogo. E [quanto à] carne, todo aquele que estiver puro poderá comer [da] carne.
pt.B: Se a carne tocar em qualquer coisa impura, ninguém poderá comê-la; será queimada no fogo. Fora isso, a carne poderá ser comida por qualquer pessoa que estiver pura.
pt.R: Se a carne tocar em alguma coisa impura, ela não pode ser comida. Deve ser toda queimada. Qualquer pessoa que estiver pura pode comer o resto da carne.

am.L: ርኩስ የሆነውን ነገር ሁሉ የሚነካ ሥጋ አይበላም፤ በእሳት ይቃጠላል፤ [ስለ] ሥጋውም፣ ንጹሕ የሆነ ሁሉ ሥጋውን ይበላል።
am.B: ሥጋው ርኩስ የሆነ ማንኛውንም ነገር ቢነካ ማንም አይብላው፤ በእሳት ይቃጠል። ያለዚያ ግን ንጹሕ የሆነ ማንኛውም ሰው ሥጋውን ሊበላ ይችላል።
am.R: ሥጋው ርኩስ የሆነ ነገር ቢነካ መበላት የለበትም። መቃጠል አለበት። የቀረውን ሥጋ ንጹሕ የሆነ ማንኛውም ሰው ሊበላ ይችላል።

hi.L: और जो मांस किसी अशुद्ध वस्तु को छू जाए, वह खाया न जाए; वह आग में जला दिया जाए। और मांस [के विषय में], हर शुद्ध [व्यक्ति] मांस खा सकता है।
hi.B: यदि मांस किसी अशुद्ध वस्तु से छू जाए, तो कोई उसे न खाए; वह आग में जला दिया जाए। बाक़ी मांस हर वह व्यक्ति खा सकता है जो शुद्ध हो।
hi.R: यदि मांस किसी अशुद्ध चीज़ को छू जाए, तो उसे न खाना। उसे पूरी तरह जला देना। जो कोई शुद्ध हो, वह बाक़ी मांस खा सकता है।

ru.L: И мясо, которое прикоснётся к чему-либо нечистому, пусть не едят; на огне пусть будет сожжено оно. А [что до] мяса — всякий чистый может есть мясо.
ru.B: Если мясо соприкоснётся с чем-то нечистым, его нельзя есть; его нужно сжечь на огне. В остальных случаях мясо может есть каждый, кто чист.
ru.R: Если мясо прикоснётся к чему-то нечистому, его нельзя есть. Его нужно сжечь. Остальное мясо может есть любой, кто чист.

ja.L: そして何か汚れたものに触れた肉は、食べてはならない。それは火で焼かれなければならない。そして肉[について言えば]、清い者はみな肉を食べることができる。
ja.B: 汚れたものに触れた肉は、だれも食べてはならない。それは火で焼かなければならない。それ以外の肉は、清い人ならだれでも食べてよい。
ja.R: 肉が何か汚れたものにさわったなら、それを食べてはいけない。焼いてしまわなければならない。残りの肉は、清い人ならだれでも食べてよい。

uk.L: А мʼясо, яке доторкнеться до чогось нечистого, не їстимуть; його спалять у вогні. А [щодо] мʼяса, кожен чистий може їсти мʼясо.
uk.B: Якщо мʼясо торкнулося чогось нечистого, його не можна їсти; його треба спалити у вогні. В іншому разі мʼясо може їсти кожен, хто чистий.
uk.R: Якщо мʼясо торкнулося чогось нечистого, його не можна їсти. Його треба спалити. Решту мʼяса може їсти кожен, хто чистий.

decisions.choice: unclean ... clean: fit or unfit for contact with holy things
decisions.reason: Being unclean is a state that bars a person or thing from what is holy, caused by contact with death, certain animals, discharges and the like (5:2; 11:4; chapters 12-15). The meat of the peace offering is holy, so it must not touch anything unclean, and only clean people may eat it (verses 20-21).

decisions.choice: and the meat, every clean one will eat meat: anyone clean may eat it
decisions.reason: The verse first names the subject, "the meat", and then says what may be done with it. Unlike the most holy offerings (6:22; 7:6), the peace offering may be eaten by anyone who is clean, not only by priests.

decisions.choice: [as for]
decisions.reason: Literal supplies "as for" to show that "the flesh" is set at the head of the sentence as its topic.

decisions.choice: "[그 밖의] 고기는" for "and [as for] the flesh"
decisions.reason: Korean needs the contrast with the meat just mentioned; Literal brackets it, as the English Literal brackets "as for".

source.text: וְהַנֶּ֜פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־תֹּאכַ֣ל בָּשָׂ֗ר מִזֶּ֤בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַיהוָ֔ה וְטֻמְאָת֖וֹ עָלָ֑יו וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵעַמֶּֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And the person who eats meat from the sacrifice of the peace offerings which [belongs] to Yahweh, and his uncleanness [is] on him, and will be cut off that person from his kin.

en.L: But the person who eats flesh from the sacrifice of peace offerings that [belongs] to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} while his uncleanness [is] on him, that person shall be cut off from his people.
en.B: If anyone who is unclean eats meat from a peace offering that belongs to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, that person must be cut off from the people.
en.R: Suppose someone is unclean and eats meat from a peace offering that belongs to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. That person must be removed from the people.

es.L: Pero la persona que coma carne del sacrificio de paz que [pertenece] {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} teniendo su impureza sobre sí, esa persona será cortada de su pueblo.
es.B: Si alguien que está impuro come carne de un sacrificio de paz que pertenece {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, esa persona será cortada del pueblo.
es.R: Supongamos que alguien está impuro y come carne de un sacrificio de paz que pertenece {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Esa persona tiene que ser expulsada del pueblo.

fr.L: Mais la personne qui mange de la chair du sacrifice de communion qui [appartient] {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, alors que son impureté [est] sur elle, cette personne-là sera retranchée de son peuple.
fr.B: Si quelqu’un d’impur mange de la viande d’un sacrifice de communion qui appartient {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, cette personne devra être retranchée du peuple.
fr.R: Supposons que quelqu’un soit impur et mange de la viande d’un sacrifice de communion qui appartient {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Cette personne doit être exclue du peuple.

sw.L: Lakini mtu atakayekula nyama ya dhabihu ya sadaka za amani iliyo ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hali unajisi wake [u] juu yake, mtu huyo atakatiliwa mbali na watu wake.
sw.B: Mtu aliye najisi akila nyama ya sadaka ya amani iliyo mali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mtu huyo atakatiliwa mbali na watu wake.
sw.R: Tuseme mtu ni najisi, kisha anakula nyama ya sadaka ya amani iliyo mali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Mtu huyo lazima aondolewe kati ya watu wake.

ko.L: 그러나 자기 몸에 부정한 것이 있는데 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 [속한] 화목제의 희생 제물의 고기를 먹는 사람, 그 사람은 자기 백성 가운데서 끊어질 것이다.
ko.B: 부정한 사람이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 속한 화목제물의 고기를 먹으면, 그 사람은 백성 가운데서 끊어져야 한다.
ko.R: 부정한 사람이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 속한 화목제물의 고기를 먹었다고 하자. 그 사람은 백성 가운데서 쫓겨나야 한다.

vi.L: Nhưng người nào ăn thịt của sinh tế bình an thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trong khi sự ô uế của mình còn trên mình, người ấy phải bị trừ khỏi dân mình.
vi.B: Nếu có ai đang bị ô uế mà ăn thịt của tế lễ bình an thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, thì người ấy phải bị trừ khỏi dân chúng.
vi.R: Giả sử có người đang bị ô uế mà ăn thịt của tế lễ bình an thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Người ấy phải bị loại ra khỏi dân chúng.

pt.L: Mas a pessoa que comer carne do sacrifício de comunhão que [pertence] {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, estando a sua impureza sobre ela, essa pessoa será cortada do seu povo.
pt.B: Se alguém que estiver impuro comer carne de um sacrifício de comunhão que pertence {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, essa pessoa será eliminada do povo.
pt.R: Pode ser que alguém esteja impuro e coma carne de um sacrifício de comunhão que pertence {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. Essa pessoa deve ser eliminada do meio do povo.

am.L: ርኩሰቱ በላዩ ሳለ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ከሆነው ከኅብረት መሥዋዕቱ ሥጋ የሚበላ ሰው ግን፣ ያ ሰው ከወገኖቹ ተቆርጦ ይጥፋ።
am.B: ርኩስ የሆነ ሰው {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ከሆነው ከኅብረት መሥዋዕት ሥጋ ቢበላ፣ ያ ሰው ከሕዝቡ ተቆርጦ ይጥፋ።
am.R: አንድ ሰው ርኩስ ሆኖ ሳለ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ከሆነው ከኅብረት መሥዋዕት ሥጋ በላ እንበል። ያ ሰው ከሕዝቡ መወገድ አለበት።

hi.L: पर जो प्राणी अपनी अशुद्धता के रहते हुए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की मेलबलियों के बलिदान का मांस खाए, वह प्राणी अपने लोगों में से काट डाला जाए।
hi.B: यदि कोई अशुद्ध व्यक्ति {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की मेलबलि का मांस खाए, तो वह व्यक्ति लोगों में से काट डाला जाए।
hi.R: मान लो कोई अशुद्ध हो और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की मेलबलि का मांस खा ले। तब उस व्यक्ति को लोगों में से निकाल दिया जाए।

ru.L: А душа, которая будет есть мясо мирной жертвы, которая [принадлежит] {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, а нечистота её на ней, — истреблена будет душа та из народа своего.
ru.B: Если кто-то нечистый съест мясо мирной жертвы, принадлежащей {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, этот человек должен быть истреблён из народа.
ru.R: Бывает, что нечистый человек ест мясо мирной жертвы, которая принадлежит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}. Такой человек должен быть отлучён от народа.

ja.L: しかし、自分の汚れが身にあるのに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のものである和解のいけにえの肉を食べる者、その者はその民から断たれる。
ja.B: 汚れている人が、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のものである交わりのいけにえの肉を食べるなら、その人は民の中から断たれなければならない。
ja.R: ある人が汚れているのに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のものである交わりのいけにえの肉を食べることがあるとする。その人は、民の中から除かれなければならない。

uk.L: А людина, яка їстиме мʼясо з мирної жертви, що [належить] {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, і її нечистота на ній, — та людина буде відтята від свого народу.
uk.B: Якщо хтось нечистий їстиме мʼясо мирної жертви, яка належить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, ту людину треба відтяти від народу.
uk.R: Припустімо, хтось нечистий їсть мʼясо мирної жертви, яка належить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}. Ту людину треба вилучити з народу.

decisions.choice: that person will be cut off from his people: lose his place among God's people
decisions.reason: This is the gravest penalty in the laws of Leviticus, used for wrongs against what is holy and against the covenant: eating sacred meat while unclean (verses 20-21), eating the fat of offerings (verse 25) or blood (verse 27; 17:10, 14), working on the Day of Atonement (23:29-30), and sexual sins (18:29). The passive does not say who acts. In 17:10 and 20:3-6 God says "I will cut him off", so the penalty is often God's own act rather than a sentence carried out by the community; 20:2-3 sets the two side by side, stoning by the people and cutting off by God. What it means in practice is not stated. It may mean early death, the end of the person's family line, or being cut off from one's ancestors after death, in contrast with being "gathered to one's people" (Genesis 25:8). Exile from the community is another reading. All agree that the person loses their place in Israel.

decisions.choice: which belongs to Yahweh while unclean: holy food must not meet uncleanness
decisions.reason: The peace offering is the LORD's, so eating it is sharing in a holy meal. Uncleanness and holiness must be kept apart (verse 19; 22:3-7).

decisions.choice: cut off from his people (Literal); cut off from the people (Balanced); removed from the people (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "from her people", the pronoun agreeing with the feminine word for "person". Literal says "his" for the person; Balanced and Readable say "the people", as in 17:10. Readable says "removed" so that "cut off" is not taken as a bodily wound. "Must" marks a penalty, not a forecast.

decisions.choice: "será cortada de su pueblo" (L); "será cortada del pueblo" (B); "tiene que ser expulsada del pueblo" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the image of being cut off, as in Exodus 12:15; "cortada" agrees with "persona". Readable follows the English "removed". "Su pueblo" in Spanish does not say whether the person is a man or a woman.

decisions.choice: "sera retranchée de son peuple" (L); "devra être retranchée du peuple" (B); "doit être exclue du peuple" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "retrancher", as in Exodus 12:15; it agrees with "personne". Readable follows the English "removed" with "exclue". "Son peuple" does not say whether the person is a man or a woman.

decisions.choice: "atakatiliwa mbali na watu wake" (L, B); "lazima aondolewe kati ya watu wake" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "kukatiliwa mbali", as in Exodus 12:15. "Watu wake" stays at every level because "wake" does not mark a man or a woman, so the English Balanced change to "the people" is not needed.

decisions.choice: "백성 가운데서 끊어지다" (Literal, Balanced); "백성 가운데서 쫓겨나다" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew picture, whose exact force the meaning decision's footnote discusses; Readable follows the English Readable's "removed".

decisions.choice: "bị trừ khỏi dân mình" (Literal); "bị trừ khỏi dân chúng" (Balanced); "bị loại ra khỏi dân chúng" (Readable)
decisions.reason: "trừ khỏi" keeps the Hebrew picture of being cut off and leaves open how that happens, as the meaning decision does; Readable uses a plainer verb.

decisions.choice: será cortada do seu povo (L); será eliminada do povo (B); deve ser eliminada do meio do povo (R)
alternatives: será tirada do meio do povo
decisions.reason: For the Pentateuch, as Exodus 12:15: the penalty means losing one's place among God's people (m1). Literal keeps the Hebrew "cut off" as "cortada"; Balanced and Readable say "eliminada do povo", as Genesis 17:14 and Exodus 12:15 do, which names the penalty without saying how it is carried out. The feminine forms agree with "pessoa", so Literal can keep "o seu povo" without suggesting a woman.

decisions.choice: "ከወገኖቹ ተቆርጦ ይጥፋ" (shall be cut off from his people, L); "ከሕዝቡ ተቆርጦ ይጥፋ" (B); "ከሕዝቡ መወገድ አለበት" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture and "ወገኖቹ", the word of "gathered to his people" in Genesis; Balanced says he is to be cut off and perish from the people, and Readable "removed from the people", as the English Readable does (m1). This holds through Leviticus.

decisions.choice: "अपने लोगों में से काट डाला जाए" (L); "लोगों में से काट डाला जाए" (B); "लोगों में से निकाल दिया जाए" (R)
decisions.reason: To be cut off is to lose one's place among God's people (m1). Literal and Balanced keep the image of cutting, as Exodus 12:15 does; Readable says "removed", as the English Readable does. The same through the book.

decisions.choice: "истреблена будет ... из народа своего" (L); "должен быть истреблён из народа" (B); "должен быть отлучён от народа" (R)
decisions.reason: To be cut off is to lose one's place among God's people (m1). Literal and Balanced keep the strong verb; Readable says "removed from the people", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: karet "その民から断たれる" (L), "民の中から断たれる" (B), "民の中から除かれる" (R), through Leviticus
decisions.reason: Losing one's place among God's people (meaning decision m1, uncertain); the Japanese keeps the image without deciding between death and exclusion, as the English does. The form of Genesis 17:14 and Exodus 12.

decisions.choice: "буде відтята від свого народу" (Literal), "треба відтяти від народу" (Balanced), "треба вилучити з народу" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The phrase is kept open, as the English keeps it: it may mean death or exclusion from Israel. "Відтяти" keeps the Hebrew picture; Readable uses the plainer "вилучити", as the English Readable says "removed". Book-wide choice.

source.text: וְנֶ֜פֶשׁ כִּֽי־תִגַּ֣ע בְּכָל־טָמֵ֗א בְּטֻמְאַ֤ת אָדָם֙ א֣וֹ׀בִּבְהֵמָ֣ה טְמֵאָ֗ה א֚וֹ בְּכָל־שֶׁ֣קֶץ טָמֵ֔א וְאָכַ֛ל מִבְּשַׂר־זֶ֥בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַיהוָ֑ה וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵעַמֶּֽיהָ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And a person when it touches any unclean [thing], the uncleanness of humankind or livestock unclean or any detestable thing unclean, and eats of the meat of the sacrifice of the peace offerings which [belongs] to Yahweh, and will be cut off that person from his kin.

en.L: And a person who touches anything unclean, the uncleanness of a human or an unclean animal or any unclean detestable thing, and eats of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings that [belongs] to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, that person shall be cut off from his people.'"
en.B: If a person has touched anything unclean, such as human uncleanness, an unclean animal, or some unclean detestable creature, and then eats meat from the peace offering that belongs to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, that person must be cut off from the people.'"
en.R: Someone might touch something unclean. It might be an unclean person, an unclean animal, or some disgusting unclean creature. If that person then eats meat from a peace offering that belongs to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, that person must be removed from the people.'"

es.L: Y la persona que toque cualquier cosa impura, impureza humana o animal impuro o cualquier cosa detestable impura, y coma de la carne del sacrificio de paz que [pertenece] {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, esa persona será cortada de su pueblo”».
es.B: Si una persona ha tocado algo impuro, como una impureza humana, un animal impuro o alguna criatura impura y detestable, y luego come carne del sacrificio de paz que pertenece {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, esa persona será cortada del pueblo”».
es.R: Alguien podría tocar algo impuro. Podría ser una persona impura, un animal impuro o algún bicho impuro y asqueroso. Si esa persona come después carne de un sacrificio de paz que pertenece {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, tiene que ser expulsada del pueblo”».

fr.L: Et la personne qui touche quoi que ce soit d’impur, une impureté humaine, ou une bête impure, ou n’importe quelle chose détestable impure, et qui mange de la chair du sacrifice de communion qui [appartient] {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, cette personne-là sera retranchée de son peuple.” »
fr.B: Si une personne a touché quelque chose d’impur, que ce soit une impureté humaine, une bête impure ou quelque créature impure et détestable, et qu’elle mange ensuite de la viande du sacrifice de communion qui appartient {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, cette personne devra être retranchée du peuple.” »
fr.R: Quelqu’un peut toucher quelque chose d’impur. Ce peut être une personne impure, une bête impure ou une bestiole impure et dégoûtante. Si cette personne mange ensuite de la viande d’un sacrifice de communion qui appartient {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, elle doit être exclue du peuple.” »

sw.L: Na mtu atakayegusa kitu chochote najisi, unajisi wa binadamu au mnyama najisi au chukizo lolote najisi, kisha akala nyama ya dhabihu ya sadaka za amani iliyo ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mtu huyo atakatiliwa mbali na watu wake.'"
sw.B: Mtu akigusa kitu chochote najisi, kama unajisi wa binadamu, mnyama najisi, au kiumbe chochote najisi cha kuchukiza, kisha akala nyama ya sadaka ya amani iliyo mali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mtu huyo atakatiliwa mbali na watu wake.'"
sw.R: Mtu anaweza kugusa kitu najisi. Kinaweza kuwa mtu najisi, mnyama najisi, au kiumbe najisi kinachochukiza. Mtu huyo akila baadaye nyama ya sadaka ya amani iliyo mali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, lazima aondolewe kati ya watu wake.'"

ko.L: 그리고 어떤 사람이 부정한 것, 곧 사람의 부정이나 부정한 짐승이나 부정하고 혐오스러운 어떤 것을 만지고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 [속한] 화목제의 희생 제물의 고기를 먹으면, 그 사람은 자기 백성 가운데서 끊어질 것이다.'"
ko.B: 어떤 사람이 사람에게서 나온 부정이나 부정한 짐승이나 부정하고 혐오스러운 생물 같은 부정한 것을 만진 뒤에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 속한 화목제물의 고기를 먹으면, 그 사람은 백성 가운데서 끊어져야 한다.'"
ko.R: 어떤 사람이 부정한 것을 만질 수 있다. 부정한 사람이나 부정한 짐승이나 징그럽고 부정한 생물일 수 있다. 그런 사람이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 속한 화목제물의 고기를 먹으면, 그 사람은 백성 가운데서 쫓겨나야 한다.'"

vi.L: Và một người chạm vào bất cứ vật gì ô uế, sự ô uế của loài người, hoặc súc vật ô uế, hoặc bất cứ vật gớm ghiếc ô uế nào, rồi ăn thịt của sinh tế bình an thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, người ấy phải bị trừ khỏi dân mình.'"
vi.B: Nếu có ai đã chạm vào vật gì ô uế, chẳng hạn như sự ô uế của con người, một con thú ô uế, hay một sinh vật gớm ghiếc ô uế nào đó, rồi ăn thịt của tế lễ bình an thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, thì người ấy phải bị trừ khỏi dân chúng.'"
vi.R: Có thể có người chạm vào một thứ ô uế. Đó có thể là một người bị ô uế, một con thú ô uế, hay một sinh vật ô uế ghê tởm nào đó. Nếu sau đó người ấy ăn thịt của tế lễ bình an thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, thì người ấy phải bị loại ra khỏi dân chúng.'"

pt.L: E a pessoa que tocar qualquer coisa impura, impureza de ser humano, ou animal impuro, ou qualquer coisa detestável impura, e comer da carne do sacrifício de comunhão que [pertence] {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, essa pessoa será cortada do seu povo.'"
pt.B: Se uma pessoa tocar em alguma coisa impura, como impureza humana, um animal impuro ou alguma criatura detestável e impura, e depois comer carne do sacrifício de comunhão que pertence {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, essa pessoa será eliminada do povo.'"
pt.R: Pode ser que alguém toque em alguma coisa impura. Pode ser uma pessoa impura, um animal impuro ou algum bicho nojento e impuro. Se essa pessoa depois comer carne de um sacrifício de comunhão que pertence {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, ela deve ser eliminada do meio do povo.'"

am.L: ሰውም ማንኛውንም ርኩስ ነገር፣ የሰውን ርኩሰት ወይም ርኩስ እንስሳ ወይም ማንኛውንም ርኩስ አስጸያፊ ነገር ቢነካ፣ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ከሆነውም ከኅብረት መሥዋዕቱ ሥጋ ቢበላ፣ ያ ሰው ከወገኖቹ ተቆርጦ ይጥፋ።”»
am.B: አንድ ሰው ማንኛውንም ርኩስ ነገር፣ ለምሳሌ የሰውን ርኩሰት፣ ርኩስ እንስሳ ወይም ርኩስ አስጸያፊ ፍጥረት ነክቶ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ከሆነው ከኅብረት መሥዋዕት ሥጋ ቢበላ፣ ያ ሰው ከሕዝቡ ተቆርጦ ይጥፋ።”»
am.R: አንድ ሰው ርኩስ የሆነ ነገር ሊነካ ይችላል፤ ርኩስ ሰው፣ ርኩስ እንስሳ ወይም የሚያስጠላ ርኩስ ፍጥረት ሊሆን ይችላል። ያ ሰው ከዚያ በኋላ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ከሆነው ከኅብረት መሥዋዕት ሥጋ ቢበላ ከሕዝቡ መወገድ አለበት።”»

hi.L: और जो प्राणी किसी अशुद्ध वस्तु को छुए, मनुष्य की अशुद्धता, या अशुद्ध पशु, या कोई अशुद्ध घृणित वस्तु, और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की मेलबलियों के बलिदान के मांस में से खाए, वह प्राणी अपने लोगों में से काट डाला जाए।'"
hi.B: यदि किसी ने कोई अशुद्ध वस्तु छुई हो, जैसे मनुष्य की अशुद्धता, अशुद्ध पशु या कोई अशुद्ध घृणित जंतु, और फिर वह {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की मेलबलि का मांस खाए, तो वह व्यक्ति लोगों में से काट डाला जाए।'"
hi.R: हो सकता है कोई किसी अशुद्ध चीज़ को छू ले। वह कोई अशुद्ध व्यक्ति हो, कोई अशुद्ध पशु, या कोई घिनौना अशुद्ध जंतु। यदि वह व्यक्ति फिर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की मेलबलि का मांस खाए, तो उसे लोगों में से निकाल दिया जाए।'"

ru.L: И душа, которая прикоснётся к чему-либо нечистому, к нечистоте человеческой, или к нечистому скоту, или к какой-либо нечистой мерзости, и съест от мяса мирной жертвы, которая [принадлежит] {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, — истреблена будет душа та из народа своего.”»
ru.B: Если человек прикоснулся к чему-то нечистому — к человеческой нечистоте, к нечистому животному или к какой-нибудь нечистой мерзкой твари — и потом съест мясо мирной жертвы, принадлежащей {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, этот человек должен быть истреблён из народа.”»
ru.R: Человек может прикоснуться к чему-то нечистому: к нечистому человеку, к нечистому животному или к какой-нибудь отвратительной нечистой твари. Если такой человек потом съест мясо мирной жертвы, которая принадлежит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, он должен быть отлучён от народа.”»

ja.L: そして人が何か汚れたもの、すなわち人の汚れ、汚れた家畜、あるいは汚れた忌むべきものに触れ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のものである和解のいけにえの肉を食べるなら、その者はその民から断たれる。』」
ja.B: 人が、人の汚れや汚れた動物、あるいは汚れた忌むべき生き物など、何か汚れたものに触れてから、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のものである交わりのいけにえの肉を食べるなら、その人は民の中から断たれなければならない。』」
ja.R: 人が、何か汚れたものにさわることがある。それは汚れた人かもしれないし、汚れた動物か、汚れたいやな生き物かもしれない。その人がそのあとで、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のものである交わりのいけにえの肉を食べるなら、その人は民の中から除かれなければならない。』」

uk.L: А людина, коли доторкнеться до будь-чого нечистого, до людської нечистоти, чи до нечистої худоби, чи до будь-якої нечистої гидоти, і їстиме з мʼяса мирної жертви, що [належить] {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, — та людина буде відтята від свого народу.”»
uk.B: Якщо людина торкнулася чогось нечистого, наприклад людської нечистоти, нечистої тварини чи якоїсь нечистої гидоти, а потім їсть мʼясо мирної жертви, яка належить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, ту людину треба відтяти від народу.”»
uk.R: Хтось може торкнутися чогось нечистого. Це може бути нечиста людина, нечиста тварина чи якась огидна нечиста істота. Якщо ця людина потім їсть мʼясо мирної жертви, яка належить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, її треба вилучити з народу.”»

decisions.choice: the uncleanness of a human: uncleanness that comes from a person
decisions.reason: This means the uncleanness of a human body, such as a discharge, childbirth, skin disease or a corpse (chapters 12-15; Numbers 19:11-16). Whoever touches it is unclean in turn (5:3).

decisions.choice: detestable thing: some Hebrew manuscripts read "swarming thing"
decisions.reason: The Westminster Leningrad Codex reads "detestable thing", the word used for unclean water creatures and insects in 11:10-23. Some Hebrew manuscripts, the Samaritan Pentateuch and the Syriac read a word that differs by one letter, "swarming thing", as in the parallel 5:2 and 22:5. The sense is nearly the same: small unclean creatures. This translation follows the Codex.

decisions.choice: the speech closes
decisions.reason: This verse ends the instructions to Aaron and his sons that began at 6:18. A new speech, to all the people, begins at verse 22.

decisions.choice: disgusting
decisions.reason: Readable says "disgusting" for this word, as in chapter 11.

decisions.choice: "አስጸያፊ" (detestable, L, B); "የሚያስጠላ" (R)
decisions.reason: The detestable thing is a creature the law calls abhorrent (m2); Readable says "disgusting".

decisions.choice: sheqets "忌むべきもの" (L), "忌むべき生き物" (B), "いやな生き物" (R)

decisions.reason: The text follows the reading "detestable thing"; some manuscripts read "swarming thing" (meaning decision m2).

records.literal_gloss: Speak to the people of Israel, saying, any fat of an ox and a young ram and a goat not you must eat.

en.L: "Speak to the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, saying, 'Any fat of ox or sheep or goat you shall not eat.
en.B: "Speak to the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} and tell them: 'You must not eat any fat from cattle, sheep or goats.
en.R: "Tell the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}: 'You must not eat the fat of any cow, sheep or goat.

es.L: «Habla a los hijos de Israel, diciendo: “Ninguna grasa de buey, ni de oveja, ni de cabra {{plural_you:comerán|comeréis}}.
es.B: «Habla a los israelitas y diles: “No {{plural_you:comerán|comeréis}} ninguna grasa de ganado vacuno, de ovejas o de cabras.

fr.B: « Parle aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} et dis-leur : “Vous ne mangerez aucune graisse de bœuf, de mouton ou de chèvre.
fr.R: « Dis aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} : “Vous ne devez manger la graisse d’aucune vache, d’aucun mouton, d’aucune chèvre.

sw.L: "Sema na wana wa Israeli, ukisema, 'Shahamu yoyote ya ng'ombe au kondoo au mbuzi hamtaila.
sw.B: "Sema na Waisraeli, uwaambie, 'Msile shahamu yoyote ya ng'ombe, kondoo au mbuzi.
sw.R: "Waambie Waisraeli, 'Kamwe msile shahamu ya ng'ombe yeyote, wala ya kondoo, wala ya mbuzi.

ko.L: "이스라엘 자손에게 말하여 일러라. '너희는 소나 양이나 염소의 기름은 어떤 것도 먹지 말라.
ko.B: "이스라엘 백성에게 말하여 일러라. '너희는 소나 양이나 염소의 기름을 조금도 먹어서는 안 된다.
ko.R: "이스라엘 사람들에게 일러 주어라. '너희는 소나 양이나 염소의 기름을 먹으면 안 된다.

vi.L: "Hãy nói với con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên rằng: 'Các ngươi không được ăn chút mỡ nào của bò, hoặc chiên, hoặc dê.
vi.B: "Hãy nói với dân Y-sơ-ra-ên và bảo họ: 'Các ngươi không được ăn bất cứ mỡ nào của bò, chiên hay dê.
vi.R: "Hãy bảo dân Y-sơ-ra-ên: 'Không được ăn mỡ của bất cứ con bò, con chiên hay con dê nào.

pt.R: "Diz aos israelitas: 'Vocês não devem comer a gordura de nenhum boi, ovelha ou cabra.

hi.B: "इस्राएलियों से बात करो और उनसे कहो: 'गाय-बैल, भेड़ या बकरी की कोई भी चरबी न खाना।

ru.L: «Говори {{gender:детям Израиля|сынам Израиля}}, говоря: “Никакого жира вола, и овцы, и козы не ешьте.

ru.R: «Скажи израильтянам: “Не ешьте жира ни коров, ни овец, ни коз.

ja.L: 「イスラエルの子らに語って言いなさい。『牛、羊、やぎの脂肪は、どれも食べてはならない。
ja.B: 「イスラエルの人々に告げなさい。『牛、羊、やぎの脂肪は、どれも食べてはならない。
ja.R: 「イスラエルの人々に言いなさい。『牛や羊ややぎの脂肪は、どれも食べてはいけない。

uk.L: «Говори до {{gender:нащадків Ізраїля|синів Ізраїля}}, кажучи: “Жодного лою вола, вівці чи кози не їжте.
